title: In vivo antimicrobial assay of the PPO system using horseshoe crab as the model animal
protocol: Culture Gram-positive bacterial strains under pyrogen-free conditions as described in protocols #4 and #5.
Adjust the bacterial population to 10^6-10^7 cfu/ml with pyrogen-free 3% NaCl (isotonic to horseshoe crab hemolymph).
Inject horseshoe crab intracardially with 10^5-10^6 cfu bacteria/100 gram body using a #23 needle.
At 30 min post injection, collect hemolymph from the horseshoe crab by cardiac puncture using a #18 needle.
Immediately after collection, remove hemocytes by centrifuging the hemolymph at 150 x g for 10 min at room temperature.
Quantify remnant bacterial load in the extracellular milieu by applying 100 μl of cell-free hemolymph (from step 5) to a nutrient agar plate and incubate at 37°C overnight.
Include 5 mM PTU or 5 mM kojic acid in the bacterial injection to block in vivo PO activity, if any.
